subject: SOC2 packet shared — checking next steps and timeline for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Li <ryan.li@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + agreed next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Ryan / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of discovery
- Primary use case: embed Redwood inference for product search ranking and autosuggest across web and mobile.
- Expected monthly token volume: ~200M tokens (spiky e-com traffic) with 99th percentile latency goal of <=120ms for suggester requests.
- Data residency: US-only for PII, non-PII can be multi-region.

Agreed next steps
1) I'll share our SOC 2 summary and security FAQ (for legal & infosec) — target EOD tomorrow.
2) Karthik will scope an architecture note for the KV cache + prefix-caching approach by Friday.
3) You and Samantha to confirm procurement timeline / preferred contract owner by next Tuesday (11/11).

Questions for you
- Is there any vendor-specific compliance checklist (besides SOC 2) we should expect?
- Are there any technical redlines (e.g., no persistent caching of logs) we should be aware of?

If the above looks right I'll attach the SOC 2 packet and a short FAQ in a separate email.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — inference that scales.

Hi Ryan —

Hope you're well. Quick nudge on the SOC 2 packet I sent last Friday — curious whether Acme's security/procurement teams have any open questions or if anything is blocking the vendor review.

If the review timeline has shifted please let me know so we can align capacity and the proposed kickoff window. If helpful, Vanessa (cc'd) can offer an exception for an expedited evidence pull or a short SRE session.

Proposed micro-steps if you'd like to move forward:
- Confirm procurement owner and desired contract terms (SOW vs. PO) — one-line reply is fine.
- Let us know whether you'd prefer a 30-minute architecture Q&A with Karthik this week or next.

Thanks for any update — even a "still with security, ETA 11/17" is super helpful.

Best,
Marissa
